hypothesis: The V16 cap2 policy will reproduce at least 0.025 additional kills per multiplayer game on fresh paired worlds while preserving score, survival, self-kills, action correctness, earlier-task collection, loop windows per game, and the incidence of games containing loops.
changed_factor: The candidate is fixed to V16 cap2: the V12 t85 head proposes only BOMB, a threatened opponent must have at most one immediate move outside the blast, movement overrides are disabled, at most two learned bombs are allowed per round, and the seven-step safe-continuation follow-up is retained. The loop gate compares paired loop outcomes rather than a pooled rate whose denominator changes with survival.
controls: Same frozen checkpoint, learned t85 artifact, one-escape geometry, empty-board context, broad persistent loop guard, action mask, scenarios, opponents, slots, evaluator, all non-loop gates, and fresh paired seeds. No parameters, rewards, features, or DQN weights are changed. The former pooled loop rate remains diagnostic.
selection: Advance fixed cap2 only if every pilot gate passes. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.

expected_cost.basis: Observed V16 throughput on this PC.

pc.note: Cumulative issue #225 debit through completed V16, including its conservative recovery debit; the shared 40 CPU-hour cap is not reset.
